properties.name: Override Modifier
properties.description: In a local override object, whether this modifier comes from the linked reference object, or is local to the override

properties.name: Apply on Spline
properties.description: Apply this and all preceding deformation modifiers on splines' points rather than on filled curve/surface

properties.name: Execution Time
properties.description: Time in seconds that the modifier took to evaluate. This is only set on evaluated objects. If multiple modifiers run in parallel, execution time is not a reliable metric.

properties.name: Persistent UID
properties.description: Uniquely identifies the modifier within the modifier stack that it is part of

properties.name: Use Custom Camera
properties.description: Use custom camera instead of the active camera

properties.name: Intersection With Contour
properties.description: Treat intersection and contour lines as if they were the same type so they can be chained together

properties.name: All Lines
properties.description: Treat all lines as the same line type so they can be chained together

properties.name: Instanced Objects
properties.description: Allow particle objects and face/vertex instances to show in Line Art

properties.name: Handle Overlapping Edges
properties.description: Allow edges in the same location (i.e. from edge split) to show properly. May run slower.

properties.name: Clipping Boundaries
properties.description: Allow lines generated by the near/far clipping plane to be shown

properties.name: Crease Threshold
properties.description: Angles smaller than this will be treated as creases. Crease angle priority: object Line Art crease override > mesh auto smooth angle > Line Art default crease.

properties.name: Angle Splitting
properties.description: Angle in screen space below which a stroke is split in two

properties.name: Smooth Tolerance
properties.description: Strength of smoothing applied on jagged chains

properties.name: Loose As Contour
properties.description: Loose edges will have contour type

properties.name: Invert Vertex Group
properties.description: Invert source vertex group values

properties.name: Match Output
properties.description: Match output vertex group based on name

properties.name: Filter Face Marks
properties.description: Filter feature lines using Freestyle face marks

properties.name: Invert
properties.description: Invert face mark filtering

properties.name: Boundaries
properties.description: Filter feature lines based on face mark boundaries

properties.name: Keep Contour
properties.description: Preserve contour lines while filtering

properties.name: Image Threshold
properties.description: Segments with an image distance smaller than this will be chained together

properties.name: Chain Loose Edges
properties.description: Allow loose edges to be chained together

properties.name: Use Geometry Space
properties.description: Use geometry distance for chaining instead of image space

properties.name: Preserve Details
properties.description: Keep the zig-zag "noise" in initial chaining

properties.name: Overlapping Edge Types
properties.description: Allow an edge to have multiple overlapping types. This will create a separate stroke for each overlapping type.

properties.name: Stroke Depth Offset
properties.description: Move strokes slightly towards the camera to avoid clipping while preserve depth for the viewport

properties.name: Offset Towards Custom Camera
properties.description: Offset strokes towards selected camera instead of the active camera

properties.name: Camera Object
properties.description: Use specified camera object for generating Line Art strokes

properties.name: Light Object
properties.description: Use this light object to generate light contour

properties.name: Source Type
properties.description: Line Art stroke source type

properties.name: Object
properties.description: Generate strokes from this object

properties.name: Collection
properties.description: Generate strokes from the objects in this collection

properties.name: Use Contour
properties.description: Generate strokes from contours lines

properties.name: Use Loose
properties.description: Generate strokes from loose edges

properties.name: Use Crease
properties.description: Generate strokes from creased edges

properties.name: Use Material
properties.description: Generate strokes from borders between materials

properties.name: Use Edge Mark
properties.description: Generate strokes from Freestyle marked edges

properties.name: Use Intersection
properties.description: Generate strokes from intersections

properties.name: Use Light Contour
properties.description: Generate light/shadow separation lines from a reference light object

properties.name: Use Shadow
properties.description: Project contour lines using a light source object

properties.name: Shadow Region Filtering
properties.description: Select feature lines that comes from lit or shaded regions. Will not affect cast shadow and light contour since they are at the border.

properties.name: Silhouette Filtering
properties.description: Select contour or silhouette

properties.name: Fill Strokes
properties.description: Generate filled strokes instead of only outline

properties.name: Use Occlusion Range
properties.description: Generate strokes from a range of occlusion levels

properties.name: Level Start
properties.description: Minimum number of occlusions for the generated strokes

properties.name: Level End
properties.description: Maximum number of occlusions for the generated strokes

properties.name: Layer
properties.description: Grease Pencil layer to which assign the generated strokes

properties.name: Material
properties.description: Grease Pencil material assigned to the generated strokes

properties.name: Source Vertex Group
properties.description: Match the beginning of vertex group names from mesh objects, match all when left empty

properties.name: Vertex Group
properties.description: Vertex group name for selected strokes

properties.name: Is Baked
properties.description: This modifier has baked data

properties.name: Use Cache
properties.description: Use cached scene data from the first Line Art modifier in the stack. Certain settings will be unavailable.

properties.name: Overscan
properties.description: A margin to prevent strokes from ending abruptly at the edge of the image

properties.name: Radius
properties.description: The radius for the generated strokes

properties.name: Opacity
properties.description: The strength value for the generate strokes

properties.name: Use Material Mask
properties.description: Use material masks to filter out occluded strokes

properties.name: Match Masks
properties.description: Require matching all material masks instead of just one

properties.name: Masks
properties.description: Mask bits to match from Material Line Art settings

properties.name: Match Intersection
properties.description: Require matching all intersection masks instead of just one

properties.name: Masks
properties.description: Mask bits to match from Collection Line Art settings

properties.name: Crease On Smooth Surfaces
properties.description: Allow crease edges to show inside smooth surfaces

properties.name: Crease On Sharp Edges
properties.description: Allow crease to show on sharp edges

properties.name: Image Boundary Trimming
properties.description: Trim all edges right at the boundary of image (including overscan region)

properties.name: Back Face Culling
properties.description: Remove all back faces to speed up calculation, this will create edges in different occlusion levels than when disabled

properties.name: Shadow Camera Near
properties.description: Near clipping distance of shadow camera

properties.name: Shadow Camera Far
properties.description: Far clipping distance of shadow camera

properties.name: Shadow Camera Size
properties.description: Represents the "Orthographic Scale" of an orthographic camera. If the camera is positioned at the light's location with this scale, it will represent the coverage of the shadow "camera".

properties.name: Invert Collection Filtering
properties.description: Select everything except lines from specified collection

properties.name: Invert Silhouette Filtering
properties.description: Select anti-silhouette lines
